goal: Prevent local cross-user RPC credential theft when another process holds the default IPv4 port
Ensure the RPC server fails closed if requested or default loopback binds cannot be established
agreement: Support because bitcoin-cli defaults to IPv4 and needs a matching listener (winterrdog)
Resolved concern that IPv6-only hosts lacked guidance when IPv4 bind fails (winterrdog)
Concept approval without stated reasons (l0rinc, janb84, sedited)

categories.name: rpc
why: P1 because it closes a local security hole where plaintext RPC cookies can leak to a rogue local process
Protects multi-user systems from credential theft when bitcoind fails to bind its default IPv4 port
